confidence_policy.m11_routing_threshold_status: exploratory only; do not apply as abstention or default review routing

encoder.adapted_weight_provenance: none; frozen pretrained encoder; only CLS linear head was trained

score_contract.face_down: must be predicted from image pixels; no reviewed-side shortcut
score_contract.ranking: softmax(logits / locked_temperature), descending probability, stable target-index tie break
score_contract.unknown_or_unusable_output: DINO has no UNKNOWN output; inference failures remain in the denominator and reduce usable coverage
score_contract.unsupported_label_prediction: counts as incorrect for eligible campaign labels; do not drop or renormalize outputs

candidate.selection: M3 seed-17 frozen CLS control; M6 did not pass the frozen challenger rule

supported_inputs.crop_origin: reviewed oracle_visible_region crop from the frozen 0086 handoff
supported_inputs.semantic_input: one eligible visible card crop per sample, including pixel-based face-down recognition

evaluation_contract.failed_or_missing_predictions: remain in the denominator and count against usable coverage; report each failure class
evaluation_contract.paired_population: same exact reviewed native PPM crops for DINO and Gemini
evaluation_contract.per_crop_correctness: exact canonical visual label match; UNKNOWN, unsupported NINE output, missing prediction, or provider failure is incorrect for a supported positive target

quality_gates.selection_rule: prefer a challenger only when top-1 improves by at least 1 percentage point, the paired source-group bootstrap interval excludes zero, and no class falls by more than 2 percentage points; otherwise keep the qualifying control or report inconclusive

gemini_reference.input: same reviewed native PPM crop; classifier converts it to PNG; DINO uses its frozen resize and letterbox transform
gemini_reference.prompt:
This image is a transformed crop of one visible Doppelkopf playing card.

Identify its visible suit and rank using the canonical card label in the response schema. Return FACE_DOWN when the visible card back is positively recognizable. Return UNKNOWN when the crop is too occluded, too blurred, or otherwise cannot support a reliable visual classification. Do not guess. This is visual evidence only; do not infer a physical card, a card play, a trick, or game state.

test_membership.known_limit: One source group cannot meet the frozen three-group uncertainty floor. Final evidence cannot establish source-group generalization.
test_membership.membership_rule: Use all eligible reviewed positive crops from this exact frozen recording and source group. Before scoring, materialize once and confirm exactly 108 expected crops. If resolved membership differs, stop without scoring and record the mismatch.
